name: U-NEXT HOLDINGS Co.,Ltd.
summary: U-NEXT HOLDINGS Co.,Ltd. provides entertainment services. It operates through Content distribution business, Store and facility solutions business, Telecommunications and Energy Business, Global Financial and Real Estate Business, and Inter-segment Internal Transactions segments. It offers video distribution services; and provides, sells, and installs store solutions, including music distribution, as well as develops and manages music copyrights. The company also provides business management services for hotels, hospitals, golf courses, etc., as well as develops, manufactures, and sells management systems and automatic payment machines.
